name: Glovo
description:
Glovo in Claude helps you find anything you need in your city and get it delivered wherever you are in just minutes. Just ask in your own words for what you need: skincare, gifts, clothes, electronics, pet supplies, supermarkets, or even flowers.

You can also refine results by budget, brand, features, ratings, and your preferred stores, and view live availability, prices, and store details.

When you're ready to order, Claude takes you directly to the Glovo app or website to complete your purchase. As easy as that.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Glovo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Glovo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.glovoapp.com/discovery-mcp/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Glovo MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, Glovo scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Glovo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Glovo provides these MCP tools: search_products and render_products_carousel.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Glovo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Glovo in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Glovo does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Why is Glovo failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Glovo scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is Authenticated MCP access is available. Reconnect the server account or provide a valid refreshable OAuth session, then rerun the audit. Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Glovo is developed by Glovo. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
